content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

The sovereign digital commerce stack is a bespoke combination of free and paid tools, designed to empower creators with a fully operational online store. This stack includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. By utilizing GitHub Pages for hosting, creators can circumvent platform restrictions and fees, ensuring they retain the majority of their earnings. For instance, NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% fee, unlike Gumroad's 10% commission, which can result in a significant difference of $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this sovereign stack relies on a synergy of components, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Additionally, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 enables file delivery, while NOWPayments facilitates automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This harmonious integration ensures a seamless and efficient transaction process, allowing creators to focus on producing high-quality digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or heavily restricted. These individuals can now sell their digital products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and presets, without relying on middlemen or incurring exorbitant fees. By leveraging this sovereign stack, creators can maintain ownership and control over their digital commerce, ensuring they receive fair compensation for their work.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks empower creators to maintain ownership and control over their online stores.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The cornerstone of this architecture is the combination of GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. GitHub Pages provides a free and reliable hosting solution, while NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment processing with a minimal 0.5% fee. Other essential components include Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This synergy of components creates a robust and efficient digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can start by selecting a hosting solution, such as GitHub Pages, and integrating it with a backend logic component, like Cloudflare Workers. Next, they can set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets and configure file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, by incorporating NOWPayments, creators can enable automatic crypto payment processing and start selling their digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack, leveraging GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This solution allows for automatic on-chain payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, ensuring creators retain the majority of their earnings. With a minimal 0.5% fee from NOWPayments, creators can significantly increase their revenue compared to traditional platforms like Gumroad, which charges a 10% commission.
NOWPayments' 0.5% fee significantly reduces transaction costs compared to traditional platforms.

This kit provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a digital commerce stack, with a total value of $348. To learn more and purchase the Complete Builder Kit, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and start building your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: select a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, integrate a backend logic component such as Cloudflare Workers, set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets, configure file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and incorporate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. Next, create a digital product, such as an ebook or course, and load it onto your platform. Finally, test your stack to ensure seamless transactions and start selling your digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal 0.5% fee, significantly lower than traditional platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%.
Can I use this stack to sell digital products other than ebooks?
Yes, this sovereign stack can be used to sell various digital products, including courses, templates, fonts, presets, and more.
Do I need to have coding knowledge to deploy this stack?
While some technical knowledge is beneficial, it's not necessary to have extensive coding experience to deploy this stack, as the components are designed to be user-friendly and integrable.
How do I ensure the security of my digital commerce stack?

By utilizing a combination of secure components, such as Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, and following best practices for security and data protection, you can ensure the integrity of your digital commerce stack.
Can I scale my digital commerce stack as my business grows?
Yes, this sovereign stack is designed to be scalable, allowing you to easily integrate new components and increase capacity as your business grows and evolves.
